label: Messmör
note: Swedish; whey only, boiled down until it caramelises, no cream or sugar.

about.text: Swedish whey spread: whey boiled down until it caramelises into a soft, brownish spread. Unlike Norwegian prim, no cream or sugar is mentioned.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Like brunost, the water is boiled off and the lactose caramelises, but it is stopped at a soft spreadable stage. The Swedish page gives no times, ratios or fat percentages.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Until it caramelises and turns brownish, in open copper kettles.

facts.v: Pushed further, it becomes mesost (whey cheese)
